{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Verify the cleaning
print("First 5 cleaned revenue values:", df['revenue_clean'].head().tolist())

# Check for internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
internal_test_count = (df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99).sum()
print("Number of internal test orders (revenue == 999999.99):", internal_test_count)

# Check if any 'completed' orders have revenue = 999999.99
completed_internal = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99)]
print("Completed orders with revenue 999999.99:", len(completed_internal))"}
